label: Radio-Canada International, September 24, 2021: B.C. court drops extradition case after Meng Wanzhou enters deferred prosecution agreement in U.S. (media only)
notes: Media report posted September 24, 2021 (media only): Meng Wanzhou 'enters deferred prosecution agreement in U.S.' and the B.C. court dropped the extradition case; a photo caption is dated Friday, Sept. 24, 2021. This closes the date gap left by the CRS report. The Justice Department agreement page returned no text.
